records.title: B Main isolation with Market flash
records.description: Place Shear across the B Main exit so an attacker must leave the entrance smoke to trigger it. Put a Razorvine beside the stairs to cover the plant cubby. Place Arc Rose on the ledge beside the orange Market sign. Hold from back site; activate the vine when the wall separates the entry, then flash before peeking.

records.title: A Main corner isolation and choke trap
records.description: Set Shear across the A Main exit with its end tucked into the corner beside the green crate. Place Razorvine in the choke behind it. Keep Arc Rose below the overhead beam so the beam does not block it. Once the wall isolates the entry, activate the vine and flash before fighting from cover.
